full_judgment: 21. In the instant case not only Cherag Ali was a person well known in the locality but also a close relation of the registering officer (SR) himself, being the husband of a sister's daughter of Cherag Ali. Not only that, it is seen from the records that Cherag Ali was also exempted previously from putting thumb impression on documents executed and registered in 1918 and 1950 and when his son PW 1 Lutful Karim was confronted with those 2 documents, he admitted that fact so the finding of the learned lower appellate Court is not acceptable on this score.
